notes: User reported a real customer's watchlist showing 0 systems despite being a real, correctly-listed watchlist in the sidebar. Traced to a live harvest: Active IQ's GraphQL API rejected that specific watchlist's systems query at the richest 'TAM/full' tier with 'Float cannot represent non numeric value: null'. The harvester's existing 3-tier fallback (TAM -> Efficiency -> Minimal) only checked success at the whole-account level, so once 3 of the account's 4 watchlists succeeded at the TAM tier, the tier was declared a success account-wide and the one failing watchlist was never retried at a smaller field set -- its systems were silently dropped every harvest. Fixed: the tier fallback now applies per-watchlist, independent of whether sibling watchlists already succeeded. Verified live: the previously-empty watchlist now correctly retries at the Efficiency tier and returns all 78 of its systems.
